text: The Ready to Rebuild (R2R) Program is a collaborative initiative between the World Bank and the Government of the Philippines aimed at enhancing disaster rehabilitation and recovery. It provides national and local officials with a standardized 'playbook' for pre- and post-disaster recovery planning, including tools, templates, and operational guidance. The program is integrated with the GeoRiskPH multi-hazard database and aligns with catastrophe financing strategies to ensure effective and timely recovery efforts.
